subject.title: Request analysis - Anthropic Admin provider: optional per-workspace spend breakdown

question: Should CodexBar add an opt-in Anthropic Admin workspace spend breakdown, and should it appear as stacked provider cards or a bounded detail/chart surface?
rationale: The upstream API supports workspace attribution, but choosing the menu-bar information hierarchy, toggle location, and behavior for many workspaces is a product and UX decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor bounded opt-in breakdown
options.body: Keep the organization summary as the default and define a capped workspace detail UI with focused fetch/parser/UI tests.

options.title: Keep organization-only scope
options.body: Decline the additional menu surface and continue directing detailed workspace analysis to the Anthropic Console.

options.title: Request a design spike first
options.body: Ask for a small prototype or mockup that demonstrates labels, ordering, default-workspace handling, and behavior with many workspaces before approving implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded opt-in breakdown
recommendation.body: Keep the organization summary as the default and define a capped workspace detail UI with focused fetch/parser/UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about CodexBar’s product scope and menu information density.
